material_difference: FCC-001 is single-venue Binance spot + USD-M perpetual cash-and-carry.
No Hyperliquid/native oracle, cross-venue basis, or oracle reconstruction is used.
Primary payment mechanism is persistence of future perpetual funding after an observed extreme positive funding settlement.
Directional BTC beta is hedged by long spot / short perp.

mechanism: Leveraged long demand creates positive perpetual funding paid to shorts. Extreme positive funding may persist across the next several settlements. A fully hedged long-spot/short-perp position can harvest that funding while minimizing directional BTC exposure, subject to basis movement and trading costs.

signal.decision: Immediately after a funding settlement t is observed.
signal.threshold: current funding > 0 AND >= past-only trailing 90th percentile
signal.entry: 1h bar OPEN at t + 1h for both spot and perp
signal.exit: 1h bar OPEN at t + 25h for both spot and perp
signal.position: long 1 BTC spot + short 1 BTC perpetual
signal.overlap: one active position at a time

funding_receipts.included_settlements: funding timestamps strictly after t and <= t+24h
funding_receipts.approximation: payment_i = funding_rate_i * perp_1h_open_at_settlement for a 1 BTC short; positive funding is received by the short

pnl.note: 30 bps approximates 20 bps spot round-trip plus 10 bps futures round-trip without VIP/BNB discounts.

coverage_gate.full: at least 46 common months and >=11 months in every year
coverage_gate.limited: at least 36 common months and >=8 months in every year

no_rescue: Do not change 90th percentile after outcomes.
Do not change 24h hold after outcomes.
Do not include the already-paid funding at signal time.
Do not reduce 30 bps primary cost after outcomes.
Do not add OI, trend, volatility or trader-ratio filters after outcomes.
